about: Registered explanations of gate failures (docs/PREREG_observer_advantage_keys.md, section 8). Each pins the numbers it explains; a rerun that changes them is unexplained again.

dispositions.explanation: The scored Colab A100 cell misses G1 by 0.07 qasper points, less than the 0.09 by which the same cell differs between GPUs; on the recording hardware class (Atlas GV100) the cell meets G1 (qasper 29.71 vs 28.74, perplexity -0.08%). The failure is within cross-GPU variation. Not explained: today's nf4a scores above the record on all three Tier A models (+0.18 to +1.07 qasper), within G1's tolerance on the recording hardware. Amendment 4's attribution to A100 numerics was contradicted by the test (Amendment 8).

direct_test.cell: mistral-7b-instruct/nf4a on Atlas GV100, root keys_g1_gv100 (Amendment 7)
direct_test.contradicts: attribution to A100 numerics (GV100 29.71 vs A100 29.81)
